# One9Founders
> India's largest AI tools, agents, and LLMs directory for startup founders.

One9Founders helps Indian startup founders discover, compare, and choose AI tools. We review 1,200+ AI tools, agents, LLMs, and RAG/Vector DB solutions with INR pricing, security ratings, and use-case guidance.

## Key pages
- Homepage: https://one9founders.com
- Compare AI Tools: https://one9founders.com/compare
- AI Agents Directory: https://one9founders.com/agents
- LLM Explorer: https://one9founders.com/llms
- AI Tool Stacks: https://one9founders.com/stacks
- AI News: https://one9founders.com/ai-news
- Submit a Tool: https://one9founders.com/submit

## About
- Founded for Indian startup founders
- All tools reviewed on a 10-point security framework
- INR pricing shown wherever available
- Updated daily with new tools, agents, and LLM benchmarks
